title: HCI-Core request transaction log
description: Log of the accepted requests (req & gnt) observed on an hci_core_intf interface by the hci_transaction_tracer module.

schema.description: Schema tag, used to detect that the right kind of log was passed to a tool.

path.description: Hierarchical path of the tracer instance that produced this log.

transactions.description: Requests in the order in which they were accepted.

hex.description: Unsigned value, hexadecimal. A '0x' prefix, '_' separators and upper case are all accepted; 'x' and 'z' nibbles denote bits that were unknown in the simulator.

interface.description: Design-time parameters of the traced HCI-Core interface.

BW.description: Number of data bits covered by one byte-enable bit (8 by default).

UW.description: User side-channel width, in bits; 0 means the side channel is unused and is not logged.

IW.description: ID side-channel width, in bits; 0 means the side channel is unused and is not logged.

EW.description: Data ECC side-channel width, in bits; 0 means the side channel is unused and is not logged.

EHW.description: Handshake ECC width, in bits. Not logged per transaction; recorded for completeness.

seq.description: Index of this request in the log, from 0.

cycle.description: Clock cycle of the req & gnt handshake, counted from the release of rst_ni. Metadata for waveform cross-reference only: it is never compared.

wen.description: HCI write-enable polarity: 1 for a LOAD (read), 0 for a STORE (write). Note that 'write enable asserted' therefore means wen == 0, and that data/be are only meaningful in that case.

data.description: Write data, DW bits. Meaningful only for a STORE (wen == 0).

be.description: Byte enable, DW/BW bits; bit i qualifies data bits [BW*(i+1)-1 : BW*i].

user.description: User side channel, UW bits. Present only when UW > 0.

id.description: ID side channel, IW bits. Present only when IW > 0.

ecc.description: Request data ECC side channel, EW bits. Present only when EW > 0.
